environment: Windows 11 Pro 10.0.26300 x64, MSVC 14.51.36231 (Visual Studio 18 Community), CMake 4.4.4, loopback 127.0.0.1
game_exe_sha256: N/A (prototype does not touch the game)
errors: Original failure: host packets_in=0; clients state connecting -> failed (connect_timeout) after 5 s.
objective: Explain an E2E run where the host received 0 packets and both clients failed with connect_timeout.
hypothesis: Freshly linked executables start late on first launch (likely an antivirus scan), so the clients' 5 s connect window can expire before the host listens, or vice versa.
procedure: Deleted and relinked mordor-host.exe/mordor-client.exe, then ran the E2E immediately (twice); compared join times with runs that used already-launched binaries.
expected_result: Joins later than usual right after a relink; normal on subsequent runs.
observed_result: Normal join at about 390 ms after host start; right after a relink, joins at 890-990 ms. The original 0-packet failure was not reproduced. The cause is not confirmed: it is consistent with first-launch scanning, but no antivirus logs were examined. Mitigation: scripts/test.ps1 now waits for the host_started log line before starting clients.
follow_up: If it recurs, check the Windows Defender operational event log around the run time.
